content.short: Cardashift, the launchpad in service of social and environmental impact.
content.description: Cardashift aims at fostering social and environmental transitions by creating a community-governed ecosystem of products based on the Cardano Blockchain. Our upcoming product, the Cardashift Launchpad, will be the first launchpad on blockchain for impactful projects. We are setting up a unique system for selecting these projects by involving the community and accelerating them with a team of skilled professionals.
content.meta: Find out about Erable (CLAP) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
